influences.name: Mahmoud Darwish
influences.context: It's based on a translation of a poem by Mahmoud Darwish, the famous Palestinian poet. And the poem, in its title, has the words 'Kama Sutra.' It's actually specifically about waiting for a woman to orgasm. I had no idea when I first heard it and when I started writing this song. And it's beautiful. He is great… I knew nothing about him, and then I discovered him, and his poetry is extraordinary.

influences.name: Jeremy Scahill
influences.context: I derived encouragement from the work of certain documentary filmmakers. I mentioned Jeremy Scahill and his movie Dirty Wars.

influences.name: Chelsea Manning
influences.context: I derived encouragement from the work of certain documentary filmmakers. I mentioned Jeremy Scahill and his movie Dirty Wars. And also the extraordinary fortitude and courage of Chelsea Manning and Edward Snowden and Ray McGovern and Daniel Ellsberg and all the other whistleblowers that have emerged from the ashes of the Vietnam War.
